checks.detail: 36 commits scanned, no leaks found. The gitleaks download matched the official SHA 256 fingerprint.

checks.detail: In a throwaway repository a made up fake token was REFUSED and a harmless commit was ACCEPTED. The config is committed as .pre-commit-config.yaml.

checks.detail: 6 high findings in web and hq, all one advisory: picomatch 4.0.7 ReDoS (GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf), pulled in by vitest, vite and tinyglobby. 4.0.7 is the newest published version and is also affected, so no fix exists. The suggested fix is a major downgrade of vitest.
checks.limit: Review date 2026-12-16. Judged low practical risk: development only, not shipped, and only our own glob patterns reach it. This is my judgement, not a proof. My earlier quick check used --omit=dev and missed it.
